g.title: Sequence
g.text: Content discovery, browser detection, atomic state, and scoped moderation

g.title: start
g.text: 2 Scheduler / CLI begins a bounded cycle
under an exclusive JSON state lock

g.title: ratings
g.text: 3 If enabled, Graph API checks Page ratings first
new Arabic keyword match → alert only

g.title: discover
g.text: 4 Graph API discovers Page post IDs

g.title: scan
g.text: within configured page and actor caps

g.title: validate
g.text: 6 Match ANGRY / HAHA label + icon-source marker
then accept numeric profile links only

g.title: state
g.text: and preserve each target's stored status

g.title: select
g.text: 9 Select a bounded set where status = pending

g.title: origin
g.text: 10 Reverify the target's originating Page identity

g.title: block
g.text: and submit block through Facebook UI
